instruction: Ermittle alle Nummern, die ausschließlich vor 16:30:00 Uhr Aktivität zeigen.
context:
-- Database: case_merged.db (SQLite, importiert ueber Lighthouse/FQLite EtsiXmlImporter)
            -- Quelle: ETSI TS 102 657 RetainedData-XML-Exporte (Vorratsdaten-/CDR-Auskunft) eines
            -- Netzbetreibers; ein Datensatz je importierter Quelldatei in request_metadata,
            -- je Partei-Bein (Anruf/SMS) bzw. je Session (GPRS) eine Zeile in response_records.
            CREATE TABLE request_metadata (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                country_code TEXT,
                organisation_id TEXT,
                request_number TEXT UNIQUE,
                csp_id TEXT,
                timestamp TEXT,
                imported_at TEXT NOT NULL
            );

            CREATE TABLE response_records (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                request_id INTEGER,                 -- FK -> request_metadata.id
                record_number INTEGER,
                party_type TEXT,                     -- 'GPRS' | 'MOC' (abgehender Anruf) | 'MTC' (ankommender Anruf) | 'MOM' (SMS)
                national_country_code TEXT,
                national_header_id TEXT,
                nw_access_type TEXT,                 -- z.B. 'mobilePacketData', 'voiceCall'
                start_time DATETIME,                 -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
                end_time DATETIME,
                duration_seconds INTEGER,
                na_device_id TEXT,                    -- IMEI des Endgeraets
                latitude_raw TEXT,                    -- Grad/Minuten/Sekunden, z.B. 'N505638'
                longitude_raw TEXT,                   -- z.B. 'E0140849'
                latitude_dec REAL,                     -- WGS84, dezimal
                longitude_dec REAL,                    -- WGS84, dezimal
                map_datum TEXT,
                azimuth INTEGER,                       -- Ausrichtung der Sendeantenne in Grad (0-359)
                user_location_info TEXT,               -- roher 3GPP ULI-Hexstring
                imsi TEXT,
                msisdn TEXT,                            -- Rufnummer
                apn TEXT,
                other_information TEXT,
                call_indicator TEXT,
                call_action_code TEXT,
                call_subtype TEXT,
                session_id TEXT,
                type_of_data_extra TEXT,
                nat_country_code TEXT,
                nat_header_id TEXT,
                type_of_data TEXT,
                party_role TEXT,
                cell_mcc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Country Code der Funkzelle
                cell_mnc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Network Code der Funkzelle
                cell_lac_tac INTEGER,                   -- Location/Tracking Area Code
                cell_ci INTEGER,                        -- Cell-ID
                device_brand TEXT,                      -- per TAC-Lookup ermittelt
                device_model TEXT,
                source_file TEXT                        -- Name der importierten Quelldatei (Mehrquellen-Zusammenfuehrung)
            );
response: SELECT msisdn FROM response_records WHERE msisdn IS NOT NULL AND source_file='ETSI-Testdaten-Dresden' GROUP BY msisdn HAVING MAX(time(start_time)) < '16:30:00';

-- Database: case_merged.db (SQLite, importiert ueber Lighthouse/FQLite EtsiXmlImporter)
            -- Quelle: ETSI TS 102 657 RetainedData-XML-Exporte (Vorratsdaten-/CDR-Auskunft) eines
            -- Netzbetreibers; ein Datensatz je importierter Quelldatei in request_metadata,
            -- je Partei-Bein (Anruf/SMS) bzw. je Session (GPRS) eine Zeile in response_records.
            CREATE TABLE request_metadata (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                country_code TEXT,
                organisation_id TEXT,
                request_number TEXT UNIQUE,
                csp_id TEXT,
                timestamp TEXT,
                imported_at TEXT NOT NULL
            );

            CREATE TABLE response_records (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                request_id INTEGER,                 -- FK -> request_metadata.id
                record_number INTEGER,
                party_type TEXT,                     -- 'GPRS' | 'MOC' (abgehender Anruf) | 'MTC' (ankommender Anruf) | 'MOM' (SMS)
                national_country_code TEXT,
                national_header_id TEXT,
                nw_access_type TEXT,                 -- z.B. 'mobilePacketData', 'voiceCall'
                start_time DATETIME,                 -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
                end_time DATETIME,
                duration_seconds INTEGER,
                na_device_id TEXT,                    -- IMEI des Endgeraets
                latitude_raw TEXT,                    -- Grad/Minuten/Sekunden, z.B. 'N505638'
                longitude_raw TEXT,                   -- z.B. 'E0140849'
                latitude_dec REAL,                     -- WGS84, dezimal
                longitude_dec REAL,                    -- WGS84, dezimal
                map_datum TEXT,
                azimuth INTEGER,                       -- Ausrichtung der Sendeantenne in Grad (0-359)
                user_location_info TEXT,               -- roher 3GPP ULI-Hexstring
                imsi TEXT,
                msisdn TEXT,                            -- Rufnummer
                apn TEXT,
                other_information TEXT,
                call_indicator TEXT,
                call_action_code TEXT,
                call_subtype TEXT,
                session_id TEXT,
                type_of_data_extra TEXT,
                nat_country_code TEXT,
                nat_header_id TEXT,
                type_of_data TEXT,
                party_role TEXT,
                cell_mcc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Country Code der Funkzelle
                cell_mnc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Network Code der Funkzelle
                cell_lac_tac INTEGER,                   -- Location/Tracking Area Code
                cell_ci INTEGER,                        -- Cell-ID
                device_brand TEXT,                      -- per TAC-Lookup ermittelt
                device_model TEXT,
                source_file TEXT                        -- Name der importierten Quelldatei (Mehrquellen-Zusammenfuehrung)
            );
response: SELECT DISTINCT msisdn FROM response_records WHERE msisdn IS NOT NULL AND source_file='ETSI-Testdaten-Dresden' AND time(start_time) > '16:30:00';

            -- Quelle: ETSI TS 102 657 RetainedData-XML-Exporte (Vorratsdaten-/CDR-Auskunft) eines
            -- Netzbetreibers; ein Datensatz je importierter Quelldatei in request_metadata,
            -- je Partei-Bein (Anruf/SMS) bzw. je Session (GPRS) eine Zeile in response_records.
            CREATE TABLE request_metadata (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                country_code TEXT,
                organisation_id TEXT,
                request_number TEXT UNIQUE,
                csp_id TEXT,
                timestamp TEXT,
                imported_at TEXT NOT NULL
            );

            CREATE TABLE response_records (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                request_id INTEGER,                 -- FK -> request_metadata.id
                record_number INTEGER,
                party_type TEXT,                     -- 'GPRS' | 'MOC' (abgehender Anruf) | 'MTC' (ankommender Anruf) | 'MOM' (SMS)
                national_country_code TEXT,
                national_header_id TEXT,
                nw_access_type TEXT,                 -- z.B. 'mobilePacketData', 'voiceCall'
                start_time DATETIME,                 -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
                end_time DATETIME,
                duration_seconds INTEGER,
                na_device_id TEXT,                    -- IMEI des Endgeraets
                latitude_raw TEXT,                    -- Grad/Minuten/Sekunden, z.B. 'N505638'
                longitude_raw TEXT,                   -- z.B. 'E0140849'
                latitude_dec REAL,                     -- WGS84, dezimal
                longitude_dec REAL,                    -- WGS84, dezimal
                map_datum TEXT,
                azimuth INTEGER,                       -- Ausrichtung der Sendeantenne in Grad (0-359)
                user_location_info TEXT,               -- roher 3GPP ULI-Hexstring
                imsi TEXT,
                msisdn TEXT,                            -- Rufnummer
                apn TEXT,
                other_information TEXT,
                call_indicator TEXT,
                call_action_code TEXT,
                call_subtype TEXT,
                session_id TEXT,
                type_of_data_extra TEXT,
                nat_country_code TEXT,
                nat_header_id TEXT,
                type_of_data TEXT,
                party_role TEXT,
                cell_mcc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Country Code der Funkzelle
                cell_mnc INTEGER,                       -- Mobile Network Code der Funkzelle
                cell_lac_tac INTEGER,                   -- Location/Tracking Area Code
                cell_ci INTEGER,                        -- Cell-ID
                device_brand TEXT,                      -- per TAC-Lookup ermittelt
                device_model TEXT,
                source_file TEXT                        -- Name der importierten Quelldatei (Mehrquellen-Zusammenfuehrung)
            );
response: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM response_records WHERE time(start_time) BETWEEN '10:00:00' AND '12:00:00';
